title: Preserve live agent profiles when integrating stories

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage: Caught

**Story and revision.** `.planning/seeds/SEED-010-learn-from-execution-retrospectives.md#preserve-live-profiles-during-integration`, completed work at `29cc4f0d289e0584c38f766d4a08d503d1fc4d9c` (plan `.planning/slice-plans/522-preserve-live-profiles-during-integration/PLAN.md`).

**Promise.** Key example 1 (inferred directory rename): when trunk completes story A, whose profile was the only one in `agents/`, and story B's branch has added `agents/b.json`, integrating through the backlog merge adapter keeps `agents/b.json` unchanged, adds `done/A.json` with a catalog listing A, puts no profile in `done/`, and reports no file-location conflict.

**Fault.** In `src/skills/dough-product-backlog/scripts/product-backlog-git-merge.mjs`, `mergeOperation`, removed the `"-c", "merge.directoryRenames=false"` arguments from the adapter's `git merge --no-commit --no-ff <ref>` call (slice 1's fix), so the merge ran with Git's default directory-rename handling. Fixture and assertions untouched.

**Fixture and assertion.** `tests/support/product-backlog-git-merge-live-profile.test.mjs`, test "merging trunk that completed the story holding the last profile keeps the branch's own new profile in agents/" (real scratch repo, real `take`/`complete`, real adapter CLI `merge --ref main`), checked by `assertAcceptedKeeping` (exit 0 and `accepted`, no `ls-files -u` entries, two parents, live profile blob at `agents/joey-chan.json`, `done/` holding only `.catalog.json` and `A_A.json`, current catalog).

**Runs** (scratch detached worktree under the job tmp directory at the selected revision, clean before probing, `npm ci`; command `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES bash scripts/test.sh tests/support/product-backlog-git-merge-live-profile.test.mjs`):
- Baseline: exit 0, runner outcome `passed` for the file. A supplementary `node --test --test-reporter=tap` run of the same file showed 3 tests, 3 passed, 0 skipped, including the selected test.
- Fault: exit 1, outcome `failed`. A spec-reporter run showed the selected test and its sibling (example 3 shape: the branch completes the last profile's story while trunk takes C) failing at `assertAcceptedKeeping` line 71 (`merged.code`: actual 1, expected 0). The adapter reported that the merge could not be committed because something unrelated was unresolved. The index it dumped shows the wrong behavior on the intended path, independent of the exit code: `D .planning/agents/joey-chan.json` and `AU .planning/done/joey-chan.json`, which is the live profile carried into `done/` by inferred directory rename, next to `R agents/pyo-chan.json -> done/A_A.json`. The example-2 test (the continue hold) still passed, as expected, because it forces the conflict mode itself.
- Restore: the original file was copied back under an EXIT trap. `git status --porcelain` was empty and HEAD was unchanged at `29cc4f0d2`. The same command then passed (exit 0, outcome `passed`).

**Cleanup.** The scratch worktree was removed and pruned. The review checkout was never touched. Its current uncommitted changes (seed, plan deletion, ODF-430 and ODF-451) are not from this check, and I assume they belong to the concurrent wrap-up.

**Costs**
- **Test runtime.** 2.2 s baseline and 2.0 s restored (measured, from the runner's per-job times file). The baseline node reporter recorded duration_ms 2109 (measured). The fault-run times were not captured. That entry is unavailable because the times file was not requested for that run.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human took part in this check, and I have no separate measure.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No token or compute measure was exposed to this agent.
